question: Which of the following is the birthplace of Subhash Chandra Bose?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cuttack**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose** was born on **23rd January 1897** in **Cuttack**, **Orissa**.
 
• One of the **greatest freedom fighters** of India popularly known as **Netaji**.
 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose** was elected **twice** as the **president of the INC** in the **Haripura session in 1938** and the **Tripuri session in 1939**.
 
• Subhas Chandra Bose **founded** the **All India Forward Bloc** on **22ⁿd June 1939**.
 
• Subhash Chandra Bose is **believed** to have died from the **3rd-degree burn** from a **plane crash in Taiwan** on **18th August** **1945.**
 
• A few **Books written** by **Subhas Chandra bose** are:
 
 
• **An Indian Pilgrim**
 
• **Words of Freedom: Ideas of a Nation: Subhash Chandra Bose**
 
• **Jaruri Kichu Lekha**
 
• **The Indian Struggle**
 
• **Famous speeches and letters of Subhas Chandra Bose**
 
• **Letters To Emilie Schenkl**
 
 

**​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86fa2c8696a5986ad2c3b8d9ad5e5fd0b08b3438dc89c6557a602072960ce6c5.png] **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In **1921** Subhas Chandra Bose started the Newspaper known as **Swaraj.**
 
• Bose was elected as the** President of All India Youth Congress** and the** Secretary of Bengal State Congress** in **1923**.
 
• He founded an **Indian Radio Station** called **Azad Hind Radio**.
 
• Bose addressed Mahatma Gandhi as the **Father of the Nation** in **1944** in a speech broadcast by the **Azad hind Radio** from **Singapore**.
 
• **Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das** was his **Political Guru**.
 
• **Swami Vivekananda** was his **Spiritual Guru**.
